# Tasks: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) is carried into this unit's Constitution
Check as "PASS (gate carried into tasks)", and quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section names the
domain/bloc tests this unit's coverage depends on — so test tasks are generated alongside
implementation, matching RF01/RF03's existing `bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US5, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all five stories edit the one existing `InsertionModalBloc`/
`InsertionModalPage` RF01 already built (research.md's "independent" here means each story's
acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own once Foundational is done,
not that each story gets its own screen or bloc — same convention RF01's own tasks.md used). Unlike
RF01 (building fresh), this unit edits a working app: the Áudio (US1/US2) and Foto (US3/US4) handler
rewrites are sequenced so the app keeps compiling and the *other* modality keeps its RF01 behavior
until its own story phase lands — `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` and
`CaptureFailureBand` are deleted only once nothing references them any more (end of US3/US4), not
up front.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (audio review/save), US2 (audio recognition failure/retry), US3 (photo
  review/save), US4 (photo recognition failure/retry), US5 (abandoning mid-recognition or
  mid-review leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (RF01/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. Every
file this unit touches already exists inside `lib/features/capture/` or `lib/core/`; no new feature
folder, no new top-level directory (plan.md Scale/Scope).

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Project initialization — N/A for this unit.

No setup tasks apply. This unit adds no new package, no native-project change, and no new `.env`
variable — it reuses RF01's full stack as-is (plan.md Technical Context, Primary Dependencies: "No
additions"). Proceed directly to Foundational.

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The one new shared usecase every "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" trigger across both
modalities funnels through (`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`), the two new design tokens the prototype's
"Erro" states and photo thumbnail need, and the new `RecognitionErrorView` widget both modalities'
Erro states will render through. `RecognizePhotoUseCase` is **not** here — it is built in US3,
since only the Foto pipeline needs it (see US3's rationale).

**⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story work can begin until this phase is complete.

- [ ] T001 [P] Add `sizePhotoThumbnail = 64` and `sizeStatusIcon = 32` to the Sizes section of `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (research.md R2 — the "small thumbnail" and the recurring red warning icon prototype-extract.md §2.3 names for the Áudio/Foto "Erro" states and Foto's "Reconhecido"/"Erro" thumbnail; `colorError`, already present, is reused unchanged for the icon/copy color)
- [ ] T002 [P] Create `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` and sealed `ConfirmEntrySaveFailure`/`ConfirmEntrySaveOffline`/`ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed` in `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart` (data-model.md, contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md): `call(String content, EntrySource source)` checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first — `false` short-circuits to `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` without calling `CreateEntryUseCase` at all (FR-010 / Edge Cases' "both still require connectivity"); otherwise delegates to `CreateEntryUseCase(content, source)` and wraps its `Left`/`Right`. Does not re-validate `content` non-emptiness — that is the bloc's job before calling this (FR-009), the same contract `CreateEntryUseCase` itself already has
- [ ] T003 [P] Write `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` tests in `test/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase_test.dart` against a fake `CreateEntryUseCase` + fake `ConnectivityChecker` (contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md's RNF07 table): offline → `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` with `CreateEntryUseCase` never invoked; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Right(entry)` passes through unchanged; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Left(failure)` maps to `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(failure))` — depends on T002
- [ ] T004 Register `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` (as `registerLazySingleton`, injecting `CreateEntryUseCase`/`ConnectivityChecker`) in `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart` — leave the existing `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` registrations and `InsertionModalBloc`'s current constructor call untouched for now; both old usecases are still the only thing powering the Foto tab until US3 rewrites it, and Audio until US1 rewrites it — depends on T002
- [ ] T005 [P] Create a `RecognitionErrorView` widget in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/capture_status_views.dart` rendering prototype-extract.md §2.3's "Erro" shape: a `DesignTokens.sizeStatusIcon`-sized warning icon in `DesignTokens.colorError`, a `message` string, an outline "Tentar novamente" button (`onRetry` callback), and an optional secondary text-action slot (`secondaryAction` — a `(label, onTap)` pair, used only by Foto's "Salvar só a foto" in US4, left `null` for Audio). Add it **alongside** the existing `CaptureFailureBand` — do not remove `CaptureFailureBand` yet, since `AudioTabView`/`FotoTabView` still reference it until US2/US4 migrate their own "Erro" sub-views (research.md R4) — depends on T001

**Checkpoint**: `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, the two new design tokens, and `RecognitionErrorView` all
exist and are wired through DI/available to import. The Áudio and Foto tabs still behave exactly as
RF01 built them (single generic "Saving" spinner, plain `CaptureFailureBand` on failure) until their
own story phases rewrite the handlers below.

---

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Reviewing and saving a transcribed audio entry (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Stopping a recording no longer saves itself — it shows "Áudio — Processando", then lands
on an editable "Áudio — Transcrito" review with its own explicit "Salvar"; the entry created on
"Salvar" carries exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text.

**Independent Test**: Record a short note, stop, observe "Áudio — Processando", confirm "Áudio —
Transcrito" shows the transcribed text editable with "Salvar" enabled, optionally edit it, tap
"Salvar", and confirm one new entry exists with origin "audio" and exactly the (possibly edited)
reviewed text as content.

### Implementation for User Story 1

- [ ] T006 [P] [US1] Add `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` and `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)` states to `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart`; change the existing `InsertionModalAudioSaving` to carry `(text, duration)` and `InsertionModalAudioFailure` to carry `(duration, message)` instead of their current RF01 shapes (data-model.md's full `InsertionModalState` shape) — depends on Foundational
- [ ] T007 [P] [US1] Add `AudioReviewTextChanged(text)` and `AudioSaveConfirmed` events to `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart` (data-model.md) — depends on Foundational
- [ ] T008 [US1] Rewrite `InsertionModalBloc._onAudioStopRequested` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_bloc.dart`: remove the pre-transcription connectivity gate entirely (FR-001, research.md R1 — transcription is on-device and must begin unconditionally on stop); store the stopped path in `_pendingAudioPath`, capture the final `elapsed` as `duration`, emit `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)`, then await `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path)` directly — no usecase wrapper, since the only orchestration step (the connectivity check) no longer applies here (research.md R1/contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md). Before applying the result, check `state is InsertionModalAudioProcessing && _pendingAudioPath == path`; if that no longer holds, discard the result outright (research.md R6/FR-011 — User Story 5 depends on this guard existing). Otherwise map `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())`/`Left(TranscriptionError())` to `InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration, message)` (reusing the existing `_noSpeechMessage`/`_genericAudioMessage` constants), and `Right(text)` to `_audioReviewText = text; emit(InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration))` — no entry created (FR-002) — depends on T006, T007
- [ ] T009 [US1] Add an `_onAudioReviewTextChanged` handler to `InsertionModalBloc`: from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` or `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure` only, sets `_audioReviewText = event.text` and re-emits the same state subtype with the updated text, holding `duration`/other fields unchanged — depends on T006, T007
- [ ] T010 [US1] Add an `_onAudioSaveConfirmed` handler to `InsertionModalBloc`: ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioTranscribed || state is InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`, `_audioReviewText` is non-empty/non-whitespace after `.trim()` (FR-009 — the "Salvar MUST be unavailable whenever the editable text field is empty or whitespace-only" guard), and no save is already in flight for this capture (FR-010 double-tap guard); emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)`, awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_audioReviewText, EntrySource.audio)`; `Right(entry)` clears `_pendingAudioPath` and triggers the existing one-shot `closeRequests` side effect; `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` map to `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(_audioReviewText, duration, message)`, keeping the audio file and reviewed text both held so a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` is the retry (research.md R5) — depends on T006, T007, T002
- [ ] T011 [US1] Update `InsertionModalBloc`'s constructor: remove the `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` dependency, add `AudioTranscriptionRepository` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`; register the `AudioReviewTextChanged`/`AudioSaveConfirmed` handlers via `on<...>()` — leave `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` untouched (Foto is migrated in US3) — depends on T008, T009, T010
- [ ] T012 [US1] Add `InsertionModalAudioProcessing`, `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed`, and the new-shaped `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure` cases (mapping to `CaptureTab.audio`) to `InsertionModalPage._tabOf`'s exhaustive switch in `lib/features/capture/presentation/pages/insertion_modal_page.dart`, and to the page's own `BlocBuilder` tab-content switch — depends on T006
- [ ] T013 [US1] Extend `AudioTabView` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/audio_tab_view.dart` with three new sub-views: "Áudio — Processando" (a spinner — `CaptureLoadingIndicator` or equivalent — in place of the stop control, `Opacity(0.35)` around the existing `AudioWaveform`, the caption "Transcrevendo...", and the recorded `duration` in `DesignTokens.textMonoCaption` — FR-001); "Áudio — Transcrito" (an editable `TextFormField` seeded from `text`, dispatching `AudioReviewTextChanged` on change, the same `duration` caption, and a "Salvar" `ElevatedButton` enabled iff `text.trim().isNotEmpty`, dispatching `AudioSaveConfirmed` — FR-002/FR-009); "Áudio — SaveFailure" (the same editable field plus an inline message in `DesignTokens.colorError`, "Salvar" still enabled for the retry — research.md R5) — depends on T006, T007, T010
- [ ] T014 [US1] Update `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`'s `InsertionModalBloc` factory registration to inject `AudioTranscriptionRepository` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` in place of `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` (keep `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` injected for now) — depends on T011, T004
- [ ] T015 [P] [US1] Write `InsertionModalBloc` tests in `test/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` for the Audio review flow: `AudioStopRequested` reaches `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` then `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)` on a successful `transcribe()`, with no `entries-create` call made at any point in between (SC-001); `AudioReviewTextChanged` updates the held draft and re-emits the same state subtype; `AudioSaveConfirmed` with edited text creates the entry with that *edited* text (not the original transcription) and `source: audio`, then triggers the close side-effect; a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` while already `InsertionModalAudioSaving` is ignored (Edge Cases: "double-taps... only one entry is ever created"); a `transcribe()` result that resolves after the bloc has moved away from the matching `InsertionModalAudioProcessing` state is discarded, producing no state change and no entry (research.md R6); `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` returning `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` maps to `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(text, duration, message)` with the held text/duration both preserved and no entry created; a subsequent `AudioSaveConfirmed` from that `SaveFailure` state retries `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` and, on `Right(entry)`, creates exactly one entry and triggers the close side-effect; dispatching `AudioSaveConfirmed` while the reviewed text is whitespace-only (bypassing the UI's disabled "Salvar") is ignored — no entry created, no state change (FR-009/SC-005) — depends on T008, T009, T010

**Checkpoint**: User Story 1 is independently functional — Audio now shows the dedicated
Processando/Transcrito review flow end to end, and a new audio entry's content is exactly the
reviewed (possibly edited) text. The Foto tab is untouched and still behaves exactly as RF01 built
it.

---

## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Recovering from a failed transcription (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: A transcription failure shows "Áudio — Erro" with "Tentar novamente", re-attempting
transcription against the same already-held audio without a new recording; abandoning it instead
discards the audio and creates no entry.

**Independent Test**: Force a transcription failure (silent/corrupted recording), stop, confirm
"Áudio — Erro" appears with "Tentar novamente" and no entry is created, then tap "Tentar novamente"
and confirm the same held audio is retried.

### Implementation for User Story 2

- [ ] T016 [US2] Implement the Audio branch of `_onRetryRequested` in `InsertionModalBloc`: ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioFailure && _pendingAudioPath != null`; re-enters T008's transcription branch (emitting `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` first) against the same held path — no new recording required (FR-003) — depends on T008 (US1)
- [ ] T017 [US2] Extend `_onTabSelected`/`_onModalClosed` in `InsertionModalBloc` so that leaving `InsertionModalAudioFailure` (via tab switch or modal close) clears `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText` before the target state is emitted (FR-011, Edge Cases: "closes the modal... instead of retrying... no entry is created and the held audio and error state are discarded") — depends on T016
- [ ] T018 [US2] Extend `AudioTabView`'s `InsertionModalAudioFailure` case to render the new "Áudio — Erro" sub-view via `RecognitionErrorView` (warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", "Tentar novamente" dispatching `RetryRequested`, no secondary action) in place of the old generic `CaptureFailureBand` (research.md R4, FR-003) — depends on T005 (Foundational), T016
- [ ] T019 [P] [US2] Extend `InsertionModalBloc` tests for the Audio failure/retry flow: `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())` and `Left(TranscriptionError())` each map to `InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration, message)` with the correct message and no entry created; `RetryRequested` re-transcribes the same `_pendingAudioPath` without a new `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` call (SC-003); closing the modal or switching tabs from `InsertionModalAudioFailure` discards the held audio — reopening shows the idle "Toque para gravar" state, not a resumed Erro (SC-006) — depends on T016, T017, T018

**Checkpoint**: User Stories 1 and 2 both work independently — the full Audio pipeline (review,
save, failure, retry, abandon) now matches the prototype end to end.

---

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - Reviewing and saving a recognized photo entry (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Supplying an image no longer saves itself — it shows "Foto — Processando OCR", then lands
on an editable "Foto — Reconhecido" review (thumbnail + text) with its own explicit "Salvar"; the
entry created on "Salvar" carries exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text.

**Independent Test**: Supply the legible-text fixture, observe "Foto — Processando OCR", confirm
"Foto — Reconhecido" shows the extracted text editable next to a thumbnail with "Salvar" enabled,
optionally edit it, tap "Salvar", and confirm one new entry exists with origin "photo" and exactly
the (possibly edited) reviewed text as content.

### Implementation for User Story 3

- [ ] T020 [P] [US3] Create `RecognizePhotoUseCase` and sealed `PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure`/`PhotoRecognitionOffline`/`PhotoRecognitionCallFailed` in `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/recognize_photo_usecase.dart` (data-model.md, contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md): `call(String imageFilePath)` checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first — `false` short-circuits to `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` without calling `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` at all (same "don't attempt a call that cannot succeed" principle as RF01's own pre-save gate, now scoped to just this call); otherwise delegates to `recognize(imageFilePath)` and wraps its `Left`/`Right` in `PhotoRecognitionCallFailed`/`Right`. - [ ] T022 [P] [US3] Add `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(imagePath)` and `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(imagePath, text)` states to `insertion_modal_state.dart`; change the existing `InsertionModalFotoSaving` to carry `(imagePath, text)` and `InsertionModalFotoFailure` to carry `(imagePath, message)` instead of their current RF01 shapes (data-model.md) — depends on Foundational
- [ ] T023 [P] [US3] Add `PhotoReviewTextChanged(text)` and `PhotoSaveConfirmed` events to `insertion_modal_event.dart` (data-model.md) — depends on Foundational
- [ ] T024 [US3] Rewrite `InsertionModalBloc._onPhotoSourceSelected`: on a picked (non-null) path, store it in `_pendingImagePath`, emit `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)` (FR-005), then await `RecognizePhotoUseCase(path)`. Before applying the result, check `state is InsertionModalFotoProcessing && _pendingImagePath == path`; discard a stale result outright otherwise (research.md R6/FR-011). Otherwise map `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` to the existing `_offlineMessage`, `Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f))` to `f is OcrNoTextFailure ? _noTextMessage : f.message` (same branch RF01's `_photoFailureMessage` already used), both as `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, message)`; and `Right(ocrResult)` — confidence read but never branched on, per spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 — to `_photoReviewText = ocrResult.text; emit(InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text))` — no entry created (FR-006) — depends on T020, T022, T023
- [ ] T025 [US3] Add an `_onPhotoReviewTextChanged` handler (same shape as T009's audio equivalent) for `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido`/`InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure` — depends on T022, T023
- [ ] T026 [US3] Add an `_onPhotoSaveConfirmed` handler: ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoReconhecido || state is InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`, `_photoReviewText` non-empty/non-whitespace (FR-009), no save already in flight (FR-010); emits `InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoReviewText)`, awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoReviewText, EntrySource.photo)`; `Right(entry)` clears `_pendingImagePath` and triggers `closeRequests`; `Left(...)` maps to `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, _photoReviewText, message)` (research.md R5) — depends on T022, T023, T002 (Foundational)
- [ ] T027 [US3] Update `InsertionModalBloc`'s constructor: remove the `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` dependency, add `RecognizePhotoUseCase` (reusing the `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` already added in T011); register the `PhotoReviewTextChanged`/`PhotoSaveConfirmed` handlers — depends on T024, T025, T026, T011
- [ ] T028 [US3] Add `InsertionModalFotoProcessing`, `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido`, and the new-shaped `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure` cases to `InsertionModalPage._tabOf`'s switch and the page's tab-content switch — depends on T022
- [ ] T029 [US3] Extend `FotoTabView` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/foto_tab_view.dart` with three new sub-views: "Foto — Processando OCR" (an `Image.file(File(imagePath))` thumbnail sized `DesignTokens.sizePhotoThumbnail`, a spinner, and "Reconhecendo texto..." — FR-005); "Foto — Reconhecido" (the thumbnail next to an editable `TextFormField` seeded from `text`, dispatching `PhotoReviewTextChanged`, and "Salvar" enabled iff `text.trim().isNotEmpty`, dispatching `PhotoSaveConfirmed` — FR-006/FR-009); "Foto — SaveFailure" (the thumbnail, the same editable field, an inline `colorError` message, "Salvar" still enabled — research.md R5) — depends on T022, T023, T026
- [ ] T030 [US3] Update `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`: register `RecognizePhotoUseCase`; update the `InsertionModalBloc` factory registration to inject it in place of `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`; then delete `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase.dart`, `save_photo_entry_usecase.dart`, and their test files `test/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase_test.dart`/`save_photo_entry_usecase_test.dart` — both fully superseded now that Audio (US1/US2) and Foto (this story) are both migrated off them (contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md "Deleted" section, research.md R7) — depends on T027, T014
- [ ] T031 [P] [US3] Write `InsertionModalBloc` tests for the Foto review flow: `PhotoSourceSelected` reaches `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)` then `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, text)` on a successful `recognize()`, with no `entries-create` call made in between (SC-002); `PhotoReviewTextChanged` updates the held draft; `PhotoSaveConfirmed` with the current (possibly edited) text creates the entry with `source: photo`, then triggers the close side-effect; a repeat `PhotoSaveConfirmed` while already `InsertionModalFotoSaving` is ignored; a `recognize()` result that resolves after the bloc has moved away from the matching `InsertionModalFotoProcessing` state is discarded (research.md R6); `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` returning `Left(...)` from `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido` maps to `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, text, message)` with the held path/text preserved and no entry created; a subsequent `PhotoSaveConfirmed` from that `SaveFailure` state retries and creates exactly one entry on success; dispatching `PhotoSaveConfirmed` while the reviewed text is whitespace-only is ignored — no entry created, no state change (FR-009/SC-005) — depends on T024, T025, T026

**Checkpoint**: User Stories 1, 2, AND 3 all work independently — Foto now also shows its dedicated
Processando OCR/Reconhecido review flow, and both RF01-era per-modality save usecases are gone.

---

## Phase 6: User Story 4 - Recovering from a failed photo recognition (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: An OCR failure shows "Foto — Erro" with both "Tentar novamente" (re-runs OCR on the same
held image) and "Salvar só a foto" (saves immediately with a fixed placeholder, no further OCR
attempt); abandoning it instead discards the image and creates no entry.

**Independent Test**: Supply the illegible-text fixture, confirm "Foto — Erro" appears with both
actions and no entry is created yet, then separately verify (a) "Tentar novamente" re-runs OCR on

non-empty placeholder content, without a further OCR attempt.

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No tasks — proceed directly to Foundational.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: No dependencies — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–7)**: All depend on Foundational completion.

  before the DI update that injects its new dependencies; DI update before the widget sub-views that
  read the new states through `context.read<InsertionModalBloc>()`.

  existing convention of extending one shared `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` across a story's tasks
  rather than one file per task.

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
2. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
3. **STOP and VALIDATE**: record a note, stop, watch "Processando" → "Transcrito", edit the text,
   tap "Salvar" — a new "audio" entry exists with the edited text, and the modal closes. Foto still
   behaves exactly as RF01 built it.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Foundational → `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`/tokens/`RecognitionErrorView` exist, nothing visible
   changes yet.
2. Add US1 → Audio's happy-path review flow works end to end (SC-001).
3. Add US2 → Audio's failure/retry/abandon path completes the modality (SC-003, SC-006).
4. Add US3 → Foto's happy-path review flow works end to end (SC-002); both RF01-era save usecases
   are deleted.
5. Add US4 → Foto's failure/retry/"Salvar só a foto"/abandon path completes the modality (SC-003,
   SC-004, SC-006).
6. Add US5 → the cross-modality abandonment safety property is fully consolidated and tested.

  FR-013).

# Implementation Plan: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

**Branch**: `004-stt-ocr-processing` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)

**Date**: 2026-10-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
§1 (RF02), §6.2 (`/media/ocr`, `/entries`), §13 (technical constraints), `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md`
§2.3/§4, and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`, already
implemented) whose placeholder recognition UX (its own FR-007) this unit replaces for the Áudio and Foto tabs.

## Summary

RF01 already wired the real pipelines this unit needs — `whisper_ggml` transcription, the `media-ocr` call,
and `POST /entries` — but fused each modality's recognition and entry-creation into one atomic, auto-saving
step behind a plain spinner (FR-007's deliberate placeholder). This unit splits that single step into two:
recognition (transcription/OCR) now runs alone, driving dedicated "Processando"/"Transcrevendo" and
"Reconhecendo texto..." states (prototype-extract.md §2.3), and lands on an editable review state
("Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") with its own explicit "Salvar" — no entry exists until that tap. A prototype-
faithful "Erro" state replaces RF01's own deliberately plain failure band for both modalities (research.md R11
is now superseded by this unit, as spec.md's Clarification 1 always intended), adding Foto's extra "Salvar só
a foto" exit. `InsertionModalBloc`'s audio/photo handlers, `InsertionModalState`/`InsertionModalEvent`, and the
two per-modality save usecases are rewritten; `AudioTranscriptionRepository`, `PhotoRecognitionRepository`, and
every other RF01 repository/data source are reused completely unchanged — this unit adds no new network call
shape and no backend/contract change (FR-013).

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from F000/RF03/RF01.

**Primary Dependencies**: No additions. Reuses RF01's full stack as-is — `whisper_ggml` (on-device transcription,
Constitution Principle II), `image_picker`, `connectivity_plus` (via `ConnectivityChecker`), `dio` (via
`ApiClient`), `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`, `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `record` is
untouched — this unit never changes how audio is captured, only what happens after `stop()` returns a path.

**Storage**: No change to RF01's storage shape. `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private) keep
their RF01 role (the held file for a retry without re-recording/re-picking) and gain one new responsibility:
surviving the newly-split Processando→Transcrito/Reconhecido boundary, not just the old single Saving state.
`EntriesRepositoryImpl.cachedEntries` (in-memory, `get_it` `lazySingleton`) is unchanged.

**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, unchanged tooling. Coverage via
`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter (RNF07), now exercising the two rewritten
usecases below instead of `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase`. `whisper_ggml`/`image_picker` still
have no platform channel under `flutter_test` — quickstart.md covers manual iOS Simulator verification for the
new review/retry/"Salvar só a foto" flows the widget tests can't exercise.

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. No native project file touched (no new permission, no
deployment-target change) — this unit is pure Dart/Flutter logic and UI on top of RF01's already-provisioned
native capabilities.

**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app, same two feature folders RF01 created
(`lib/features/capture/`, `lib/features/entries/`) — no new feature folder. No backend/server code, no change
to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 unchanged — the `media-ocr` call still shows a loading affordance past 300 ms
(now the prototype's own spinner-plus-caption, not the generic indicator); the Áudio tab's "Processando" state
also appears immediately on stop (on-device transcription itself has no network latency to gate on, but still
renders a spinner for the duration of the Whisper inference call, which commonly exceeds 300 ms on-device).
Toggling "Salvar" enabled/disabled as the reviewed text's emptiness changes stays a local, <100 ms action
(FR-009), identical in spirit to the Texto tab's existing toggle.

**Constraints**:
- No RF04/RF05/RF06/RF07/RF08/RF09/RF10 behavior, no extension feature — FR-012 (unchanged from RF01).
- No backend/contract/config change (FR-013) — the same two functions RF01 already calls
  (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) are called with the same request shapes; this unit changes only *when* and
  *how many times* they are called relative to recognition, never their payloads.
- Audio content never reaches the backend (Constitution Principle II, FR-004) — unchanged; transcription
  stays entirely on-device, and the connectivity gate that used to run *before* transcription (RF01
  research.md R5) is deliberately removed for audio in this unit (research.md R1 below) since transcription
  itself needs no connectivity and spec.md's FR-001 requires it to start unconditionally on stop.
- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V) — the two new/rewritten usecases
  (`RecognizePhotoUseCase`, `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`) stay in `capture/domain/usecases/` and
  `entries/domain/usecases/`-adjacent territory, free of `package:flutter`/`dio`/`image_picker` types, same as
  every usecase RF01 already shipped.
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this unit, unlike
  RF01, *does* need to render the prototype's actual "Erro" iconography/copy (research.md R2 below) and a
  photo thumbnail, so it adds the small number of new tokens research.md R2 justifies.

**Scale/Scope**: 0 new feature folders; 1 new domain usecase (`RecognizePhotoUseCase`), 1 usecase
consolidation (`SaveAudioEntryUseCase` + `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` → one `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, since both
become identical except for the hardcoded `EntrySource` once recognition moves out of them — data-model.md);
8 new/renamed `InsertionModalState` subclasses (4 per modality) and 5 new `InsertionModalEvent` subclasses;
3 widget files edited (`audio_tab_view.dart`, `foto_tab_view.dart`, `insertion_modal_page.dart`'s tab-mapping
switch); 2 new design tokens (`sizePhotoThumbnail`, `sizeStatusIcon`).

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this section.*

| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only. This unit's genuinely silent spots — the exact UI for a *save-call* failure after a successful recognition (the prototype's "Erro" states are reserved for recognition failures, not post-review save failures), the fixed placeholder string for "Salvar só a foto", and whether audio transcription still needs a pre-flight connectivity check — are resolved by reasonable technical judgment in research.md R1/R3/R4, each built directly on spec.md's own already-resolved Clarifications rather than reopening them. |
| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | No new package. `whisper_ggml` stays Principle II's fixed, non-negotiable choice; audio still never reaches the backend. |
| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | The exact same two functions RF01 already calls (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`), same `ApiClient`/bearer-auth path, same AI-involved steps happening entirely inside the backend. No new function, no contract change. |
| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | The prototype's "Erro" states (red warning icon, exact copy, named retry/placeholder actions) are now faithfully rendered — RF01's research.md R11 carve-out is this unit's to close, per spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1. Two new tokens (`sizePhotoThumbnail`, `sizeStatusIcon`, research.md R2) cover the one genuinely new visual element (the photo thumbnail) and the recurring warning icon; everything else (spinner, "Transcrevendo..."/"Reconhecendo texto..." captions, editable field, "Salvar" button, frozen/faded waveform via `Opacity`) reuses RF01's existing token scale and `AudioWaveform` widget unchanged. |
| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | No new feature folder. `RecognizePhotoUseCase`/`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` live in `capture/domain/usecases/`, importing only `fpdart`, `core/network/failure.dart`, `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`, and existing domain repository interfaces — no `package:flutter`, no `data/` class. |
| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Unchanged call sites, now with the prototype's own loading affordances instead of the generic one past the same 300 ms threshold. |
| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF02 | Backend-side, unaffected by this unit. |
| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to RF02 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit. |
| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | Same `always_use_package_imports`/domain-purity convention RF01 already set up; no new violation surface introduced by splitting the two usecases apart. |
| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | `RecognizePhotoUseCase` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` are pure orchestrations of injected interfaces (`PhotoRecognitionRepository`/`ConnectivityChecker`, `CreateEntryUseCase`/`ConnectivityChecker`), as straightforwardly testable against fakes as RF01's originals — see quickstart.md. |
| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS | This unit is precisely the one that closes RF01's documented, spec-sanctioned fidelity carve-out (research.md R11 in specs/003) for the Áudio/Foto "Erro" states — see research.md R4 here. |
| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, unchanged count | Still 6/15 cumulative from RF01's `entries-create`/`media-ocr` coverage — this unit restructures *where* those three-scenario checks live (now inside `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`/`RecognizePhotoUseCase` rather than the old combined usecases) without adding a new write endpoint. `AudioTranscriptionRepository` still deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`, not the backend taxonomy (RF01 research.md R7, unchanged). |

*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*

## Project Structure

### Documentation (this feature)

```text
specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/
├── plan.md              # This file
├── research.md          # Phase 0 output
├── data-model.md        # Phase 1 output

```

### Source Code (repository root)

RF01's `lib/features/capture/` and `lib/features/entries/` already exist. This unit edits files inside them
and `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`; it creates no new top-level or feature-level directory.

```text
cerne-ciclo-a/

    ├── core/
```

4	(unchanged), and `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas (also

11	Reused verbatim from `specs/003-multimodal-capture/data-model.md` — no field, no signature, no repository
12	behavior changes. The only thing this unit changes about *how* `CreateEntryUseCase` gets called is covered

15	**Content sent for this unit's entries**:
16	
17	| Path | `content` | `source` |
18	|---|---|---|
19	| Áudio — "Salvar" from Transcrito | the editable field's current text (possibly user-edited) | `audio` |
20	| Foto — "Salvar" from Reconhecido | the editable field's current text (possibly user-edited) | `photo` |

24	
25	Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state tracking one in-progress or completed
26	transcription (audio) or OCR (photo) call for the capture currently open." As with RF01's Capture Session,
27	this lives entirely in `InsertionModalBloc`'s own state plus bloc-private fields — no other layer sees it.
28	
29	| Held where | What | Lifetime |
30	|---|---|---|

Cleared on successful save, modal close, or switching away from Áudio. | Same as RF01, extended across more sub-states. |

49	    if (!await connectivityChecker.hasConnection()) return const Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline());
50	    final result = await recognitionRepository.recognize(imageFilePath);

52	      (failure) => Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(failure)),

# Data Model: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, RF01's already-built `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`/`CreateEntryUseCase`
(unchanged), and `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas (also
unchanged — this unit calls both functions with exactly the same request shapes RF01 already used). No new
backend-shaped entity. One ephemeral, device-only "entity" from spec.md's Key Entities — **Recognition
Attempt** — is modeled as presentation state, the same convention RF01 used for its own Capture Session.

## Entry / EntriesRepository / CreateEntryUseCase (unchanged)

Reused verbatim from `specs/003-multimodal-capture/data-model.md` — no field, no signature, no repository
behavior changes. The only thing this unit changes about *how* `CreateEntryUseCase` gets called is covered
below (`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`).

**Content sent for this unit's entries**:

| Path | `content` | `source` |
|---|---|---|
| Áudio — "Salvar" from Transcrito | the editable field's current text (possibly user-edited) | `audio` |
| Foto — "Salvar" from Reconhecido | the editable field's current text (possibly user-edited) | `photo` |
| Foto — "Salvar só a foto" from Erro | the fixed placeholder `'Foto registrada sem texto reconhecido.'` (research.md R3) | `photo` |

## Recognition Attempt (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)

Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state tracking one in-progress or completed
transcription (audio) or OCR (photo) call for the capture currently open." As with RF01's Capture Session,
this lives entirely in `InsertionModalBloc`'s own state plus bloc-private fields — no other layer sees it.

| Held where | What | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `InsertionModalState` (public, contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's processing/reviewed/error/saving sub-state + the currently-editable reviewed text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open — unchanged from RF01. |
| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The already-recorded WAV path, now held across the whole Processando→Transcrito→Salvar lifecycle (not just across a failure, as in RF01), so "Tentar novamente" and a final "Salvar" both act on the same file. Cleared on successful save, modal close, or switching away from Áudio. | Same as RF01, extended across more sub-states. |
| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | Same extension for the picked JPEG path — held across Processando OCR→Reconhecido/Erro→Salvar/"Salvar só a foto". | Same as above. |
| `_audioReviewText` / `_photoReviewText` (bloc-private `String?`) | The editable field's current draft while in Transcrito/Reconhecido (or SaveFailure), seeded from the recognition result and updated by `AudioReviewTextChanged`/`PhotoReviewTextChanged`. Discarded (never read again) once the capture is abandoned or saved. | Same lifetime as the pending path above. |

**Confidence**: `OcrResult.confidence` (`"high"`\|`"low"`, unchanged type from RF01) continues to be carried
through this state but never branched on, per spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 — identical treatment to
RF01's own precedent for the same field.

## `RecognizePhotoUseCase` (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/recognize_photo_usecase.dart` — NEW)

```dart
sealed class PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
class PhotoRecognitionOffline extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
class PhotoRecognitionCallFailed extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure { final Failure failure; }

class RecognizePhotoUseCase {
  Future<Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>> call(String imageFilePath) async {
    if (!await connectivityChecker.hasConnection()) return const Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline());
    final result = await recognitionRepository.recognize(imageFilePath);
    return result.match(
      (failure) => Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(failure)),
      (ocrResult) => Right(ocrResult),
    );
  }
}
```

- Replaces the recognition half of RF01's `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` — the connectivity gate RF01 ran *before*
  OCR (research.md R5, specs/003) is preserved here, now scoped to exactly the OCR call it protects (the spec
  Edge Case "device offline when OCR would normally be attempted... MUST resolve to Foto — Erro with a clear,
  offline-appropriate message" — research.md R1 explains why audio's analogous check is removed instead).
- `PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(failure)` where `failure is OcrNoTextFailure` maps to the prototype's "Não foi
  possível reconhecer o texto" copy; any other `Failure` maps to `failure.message` — identical mapping logic
  to RF01's `_photoFailureMessage`, just relocated.
- No equivalent usecase exists for audio: `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` is called directly by
  the bloc (research.md R1 removes the only orchestration step — the connectivity check — that would have
  justified wrapping it).

## `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart` — NEW, replaces `save_audio_entry_usecase.dart` + `save_photo_entry_usecase.dart`)

```dart
sealed class ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
class ConfirmEntrySaveOffline extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
class ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure { final Failure failure; }

class ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase {
  Future<Either<ConfirmEntrySaveFailure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) async {
    if (!await connectivityChecker.hasConnection()) return const Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline());
    final created = await createEntryUseCase(content, source);
    return created.match(
      (failure) => Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(failure)),
      (entry) => Right(entry),
    );
  }
}
```

- The one and only thing `InsertionModalBloc` calls for every explicit "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" trigger
  across all three tabs (Texto's own `SaveTextEntryUseCase` is untouched by this unit and keeps its separate,
  simpler shape — it never had a recognition step to remove).
- research.md R7 documents why this single class replaces RF01's two near-identical per-modality usecases.

## `InsertionModalState` — full shape after this unit (see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md for the event-by-event contract)

```dart
// Texto — entirely unchanged (FR-012: this unit does not touch it)
class InsertionModalTexto { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoSaving { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoFailure { final String text; final String message; }

// Áudio
class InsertionModalAudioIdle {}                                          // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied {}                              // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioRecording { final Duration elapsed; }            // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioProcessing { final Duration duration; }          // NEW — "Áudio — Processando"
class InsertionModalAudioTranscribed { final String text; final Duration duration; }   // NEW — "Áudio — Transcrito"
class InsertionModalAudioSaving { final String text; final Duration duration; }        // REPURPOSED — entries-create in flight
class InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure { final String text; final Duration duration; final String message; }  // NEW (research.md R5)
class InsertionModalAudioFailure { final Duration duration; final String message; }     // REPURPOSED — transcription failed only

// Foto
class InsertionModalFotoCaptura {}                                        // unchanged
class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied {}                               // unchanged
class InsertionModalFotoProcessing { final String imagePath; }            // NEW — "Foto — Processando OCR"
class InsertionModalFotoReconhecido { final String imagePath; final String text; }      // NEW — "Foto — Reconhecido"
class InsertionModalFotoSaving { final String imagePath; final String text; }           // REPURPOSED — entries-create in flight (normal Salvar or Salvar só a foto)
class InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure { final String imagePath; final String text; final String message; }  // NEW (research.md R5)
class InsertionModalFotoFailure { final String imagePath; final String message; }       // REPURPOSED — OCR failed only
```

`InsertionModalAudioSaving`/`InsertionModalFotoSaving` and `InsertionModalAudioFailure`/
`InsertionModalFotoFailure` keep their RF01 class names but narrow their meaning now that recognition and save
are separate steps — there is no ambiguity at any call site about which phase a given state instance
represents, since each now carries only the data relevant to its narrower phase.

## `InsertionModalEvent` — additions

```dart
class AudioReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }   // NEW
class AudioSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}                           // NEW — "Salvar" from Transcrito/AudioSaveFailure
class PhotoReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }   // NEW
class PhotoSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}                          // NEW — "Salvar" from Reconhecido/FotoSaveFailure
class PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}               // NEW — "Salvar só a foto" from Foto — Erro
```

`RetryRequested`, `AudioStopRequested`, `PhotoSourceSelected`, `TabSelected`, `ModalClosed` are reused
unchanged in shape; only their handlers' internal behavior changes (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md).

## State transitions (per modality)

```
[Áudio tab]
  AudioStopRequested (from InsertionModalAudioRecording)
    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path; duration = elapsed at stop
    -> InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)                                           # FR-001 — no connectivity gate (research.md R1)
        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path)
            [state still AudioProcessing for this path — else discard, research.md R6]
            Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())  -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration, noSpeechMessage)
            Left(TranscriptionError())      -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration, genericMessage)
            Right(text) -> _audioReviewText = text; InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)  # FR-002 — no entry yet

  AudioReviewTextChanged(text) (from InsertionModalAudioTranscribed | InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure)
    -> _audioReviewText = text; re-emit the same state class with the updated text

  AudioSaveConfirmed (from InsertionModalAudioTranscribed | InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure; text non-empty, not already saving)
    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)
        ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_audioReviewText, EntrySource.audio)
            Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes                         (FR-010)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())        -> InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(text, duration, offlineMessage)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f)) -> InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(text, duration, f.message)

  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
    -> InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration); re-run the transcribe branch above against the same path  (FR-003)

  TabSelected(<anything else>) | ModalClosed, from any Áudio sub-state beyond Idle/Recording
    -> _pendingAudioPath = null; _audioReviewText = null; target state emitted (or bloc disposed)    (FR-011)

[Foto tab]
  PhotoSourceSelected(source) -> path = PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
    null (cancelled) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()
    path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)                               # FR-005
        RecognizePhotoUseCase(path)
            [state still FotoProcessing for this path — else discard, research.md R6]
            Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())            -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, offlineMessage)
            Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f)) where f is OcrNoTextFailure -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, noTextMessage)
            Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f))        -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, f.message)
            Right(ocrResult) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3]
                -> _photoReviewText = ocrResult.text; InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text)  # FR-006 — no entry yet

  PhotoReviewTextChanged(text) (from InsertionModalFotoReconhecido | InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure)
    -> _photoReviewText = text; re-emit the same state class with the updated text

  PhotoSaveConfirmed (from InsertionModalFotoReconhecido | InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure; text non-empty, not already saving)
    -> InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoReviewText)
        ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoReviewText, EntrySource.photo)
            Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes                           (FR-010)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())        -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, text, offlineMessage)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f)) -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, text, f.message)

  PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure; no further OCR attempt — FR-008)
    -> InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder)
        ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoNoTextPlaceholder, EntrySource.photo)
            Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
            Left(...) -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder, message)

  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
    -> InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path); re-run the recognize branch above against the same path   (FR-007)

  TabSelected(<anything else>) | ModalClosed, from any Foto sub-state beyond Idle/Captura
    -> _pendingImagePath = null; _photoReviewText = null; target state emitted (or bloc disposed)     (FR-011)
```

## Backend `Failure` (reused) vs. local-only failure shapes

| Type | Return type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `RecognizePhotoUseCase.call()` | `Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>` | `PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure` is a new, small local sealed type distinguishing "never called `media-ocr`" (offline) from "the call itself failed" (wraps the existing, unmodified `Failure`) — same shape of decision RF01's research.md R7 (specs/003) already made for its own local-only types. |
| `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase.call()` | `Either<ConfirmEntrySaveFailure, Entry>` | Same pattern, for the shared save step. |
| `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` | `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` | Unchanged from RF01 — on-device only, no network call, no connectivity concept applies at all (research.md R1). |

No new entry is added to `core/network/failure.dart` itself — `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` (present since
F000) still covers the illegible/blank-image case exactly, unchanged. RNF09's running scenario count is
unaffected by this unit (still 6/15, cumulative from RF01 — plan.md's Constitution Check).

## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)

Two additions — research.md R2:

```dart
static const double sizePhotoThumbnail = 64;
static const double sizeStatusIcon = 32;
```

Every other value the new states need (`colorError` for the icon/copy, `colorBorder`/`colorSurfaceElevated`
for the outline "Tentar novamente" button, the existing type scale for "Transcrevendo..."/"Reconhecendo
texto..." captions, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator` for the spinner, `Opacity(0.35)` for
the frozen waveform per RF01's research.md R10) is reused unchanged.

# Contract: `InsertionModalBloc` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/`) — RF02 changes

Same one-bloc-per-modal-open shape RF01 established (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/contracts/
insertion-modal-bloc.md`), still created fresh by `BlocProvider` on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. This
document describes only what changes for the Áudio and Foto tabs; the Texto tab's contract (`InsertionModalTexto`/
`...Saving`/`...Failure`, `TextDraftChanged`, `SaveTextSubmitted`) is unchanged and not repeated here.

```dart
sealed class InsertionModalState extends Equatable {}

// Áudio
class InsertionModalAudioIdle extends InsertionModalState {}                                          // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}                               // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioRecording extends InsertionModalState { final Duration elapsed; }             // unchanged
class InsertionModalAudioProcessing extends InsertionModalState { final Duration duration; }
class InsertionModalAudioTranscribed extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final Duration duration; }
class InsertionModalAudioSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final Duration duration; }
class InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final Duration duration; final String message; }
class InsertionModalAudioFailure extends InsertionModalState { final Duration duration; final String message; }

// Foto
class InsertionModalFotoCaptura extends InsertionModalState {}                                         // unchanged
class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}                                 // unchanged
class InsertionModalFotoProcessing extends InsertionModalState { final String imagePath; }
class InsertionModalFotoReconhecido extends InsertionModalState { final String imagePath; final String text; }
class InsertionModalFotoSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String imagePath; final String text; }
class InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String imagePath; final String text; final String message; }
class InsertionModalFotoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String imagePath; final String message; }

sealed class InsertionModalEvent {}
class AudioReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class AudioSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class PhotoSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
// TabSelected, TextDraftChanged, SaveTextSubmitted, AudioTimerTicked, AudioStartRequested,
// AudioStopRequested, PhotoSourceSelected, RetryRequested, ModalClosed — all reused unchanged in shape.
```

## Handler changes

- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the ticker, calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` for the path (stored in `_pendingAudioPath`), captures the final `elapsed`
  as `duration`, and emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` — **no connectivity check** (research.md
  R1). It then awaits `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path)` directly (no usecase wrapper — the
  repository call has no orchestration left to add). Before applying the result, it checks `state is
  InsertionModalAudioProcessing && _pendingAudioPath == path`; if that no longer holds (the user switched
  tabs/closed the modal meanwhile), the result is discarded (research.md R6). Otherwise:
  `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())`/`Left(TranscriptionError())` map to `InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration,
  message)` (data-model.md's message table, unchanged from RF01's `_audioFailureMessage` minus its
  entry-creation branch); `Right(text)` sets `_audioReviewText = text` and emits
  `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)` — **no entry created**.
- **`AudioReviewTextChanged(text)`** (from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` or
  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`): sets `_audioReviewText = text` and re-emits the same state subtype with
  the updated text, same `duration`/other fields held.
- **`AudioSaveConfirmed`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioTranscribed ||
  state is InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`, and `_audioReviewText` is non-empty/non-whitespace — mirrors the
  Texto tab's own "Salvar" guard): emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)`, awaits
  `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_audioReviewText, EntrySource.audio)`. `Right(entry)` clears `_pendingAudioPath`
  and triggers the existing one-shot `closeRequests` side effect (unchanged from RF01 — the page pops the
  sheet). `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` map to
  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(_audioReviewText, duration, message)` — the audio file and reviewed text
  both stay held; a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` is the retry (research.md R5).
- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if a save/recognition is already in flight for this tab): calls
  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` (cancelled) stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`; a path
  is stored in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)`, then awaits
  `RecognizePhotoUseCase(path)` (this one *does* go through a usecase — it still has the connectivity gate to
  perform, research.md R1 vs. audio). Same stale-result guard as audio (`state is InsertionModalFotoProcessing
  && _pendingImagePath == path`) before applying the result. `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` maps to
  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, offlineMessage)`; `Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f))` maps to
  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, message)` using the same `f is OcrNoTextFailure ? noTextMessage :
  f.message` branch RF01's `_photoFailureMessage` already used. `Right(ocrResult)` sets `_photoReviewText =
  ocrResult.text` and emits `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text)` — confidence read but never
  branched on (Clarification 3).
- **`PhotoReviewTextChanged(text)`**: same shape as the audio equivalent, for `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido`/
  `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`.
- **`PhotoSaveConfirmed`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoReconhecido ||
  state is InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`, text non-empty): same shape as `AudioSaveConfirmed`, with
  `EntrySource.photo` and `InsertionModalFotoSaving`/`InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure` in place of the audio
  states.
- **`PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoFailure`): emits
  `InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder)` directly — **no further OCR call** (FR-008) —
  then awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoNoTextPlaceholder, EntrySource.photo)` with the same
  success/failure mapping as `PhotoSaveConfirmed`.
- **`RetryRequested`**: from `InsertionModalAudioFailure` (with `_pendingAudioPath != null`), re-enters the
  `AudioStopRequested` handler's transcription branch (emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` first)
  against the same path — no new recording. From `InsertionModalFotoFailure` (with `_pendingImagePath !=
  null`), re-enters the `PhotoSourceSelected` handler's recognition branch (emits
  `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)` first) against the same path — no new picker call. A repeat
  `RetryRequested` while already `*Processing` is a no-op (the guard above already excludes it, since
  `*Processing` isn't `*Failure`).
- **`TabSelected(<anything>)`** while any Áudio sub-state beyond `Idle`/`Recording` (i.e., `Processing`,
  `Transcribed`, `Saving`, `SaveFailure`, `Failure`): clears `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText` before
  emitting the target tab's state — any in-flight or completed-but-unreviewed recognition is abandoned
  (FR-011). Same for Foto's equivalent sub-states and `_pendingImagePath`/`_photoReviewText`. The existing
  mid-`Recording` discard (`AudioCaptureRepository.discard()`) is unchanged.
- **`ModalClosed`**: extends RF01's existing "discard an in-progress recording" behavior to also clear
  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText`/`_pendingImagePath`/`_photoReviewText` unconditionally — nothing
  from an abandoned recognition/review survives disposal (FR-011), matching the `close()` override's own
  existing fallback path for the swipe-down/tap-outside dismissal case.

## Who depends on this

`AudioTabView` renders `InsertionModalAudioProcessing` (spinner in place of the stop control + `Opacity(0.35)`
around the existing `AudioWaveform` + "Transcrevendo..." + `duration`), `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` (an
editable `TextFormField` seeded from `text`, `duration` in `DesignTokens.textMonoCaption`, "Salvar" enabled
iff the field is non-empty/non-whitespace), `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure` (the same editable field plus an
inline `colorError` message, "Salvar" still enabled), and `InsertionModalAudioFailure` (the new
`RecognitionErrorView`, one action). `FotoTabView` renders the equivalent four Foto states, each additionally
showing an `Image.file(File(imagePath))` thumbnail at `DesignTokens.sizePhotoThumbnail`, and
`InsertionModalFotoFailure`'s `RecognitionErrorView` with its second action, "Salvar só a foto"
(`PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested`). `InsertionModalPage`'s `_tabOf` switch is extended with the new state
cases, same exhaustive-pattern-match convention as RF01.

1	# Contract: Recognition and save usecases (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/`) — RF02 changes
2	
3	RF01's `SaveTextEntryUseCase` is untouched (Texto has no recognition step, FR-012). This document covers the
4	two usecases this unit adds/replaces; data-model.md has their full bodies.
5	
6	## `RecognizePhotoUseCase` (NEW)
7	
8	```dart
9	class RecognizePhotoUseCase {
10	  const RecognizePhotoUseCase({
11	    required PhotoRecognitionRepository recognitionRepository,
12	    required ConnectivityChecker connectivityChecker,
13	  });
14	
15	  Future<Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>> call(String imageFilePath);
16	}
17	
18	sealed class PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
19	class PhotoRecognitionOffline extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
20	class PhotoRecognitionCallFailed extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {
21	  const PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(this.failure);
22	  final Failure failure;
23	}
24	```
25	
26	- **Preconditions**: none — callable any number of times against the same `imageFilePath` (used by both the
27	  initial automatic call on image selection and every "Tentar novamente").
28	- **Behavior**: checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first; `false` short-circuits to
29	  `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` without calling `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` at all (same
30	  "don't even attempt a call that cannot succeed" principle RF01's research.md R5 established, now scoped to
31	  this one call instead of the old combined flow). Otherwise delegates to
32	  `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(imageFilePath)` unchanged and wraps its `Left`/`Right` in
33	  `PhotoRecognitionCallFailed`/`Right` respectively.
34	- **Does not** call `CreateEntryUseCase` or touch `EntriesRepository` in any way — purely the recognition
35	  half, by design (this is exactly what used to be fused with entry creation in RF01's `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`
36	  and is now split apart).
37	- **Who calls it**: `InsertionModalBloc`, on `PhotoSourceSelected` (first attempt) and `RetryRequested` (every
38	  subsequent attempt against the same held path) — contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md.
39	
40	## `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` (NEW, replaces `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` + `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`)
41	
42	```dart
43	class ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase {
44	  const ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase({
45	    required CreateEntryUseCase createEntryUseCase,
46	    required ConnectivityChecker connectivityChecker,
47	  });
48	
49	  Future<Either<ConfirmEntrySaveFailure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source);
50	}
51	
52	sealed class ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
53	class ConfirmEntrySaveOffline extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
54	class ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {
55	  const ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(this.failure);
56	  final Failure failure;
57	}
58	```
59	
60	- **Preconditions**: `content` is expected non-empty/non-whitespace — enforced by the bloc before calling this
61	  (the "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" trigger is itself gated on that, FR-009), not re-validated here (this
62	  usecase trusts its caller, the same contract `CreateEntryUseCase` itself already has).
63	- **Behavior**: checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first; `false` short-circuits to
64	  `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` without calling `CreateEntryUseCase` (FR-010/the Edge Cases' "both still
65	  require connectivity" wording). Otherwise delegates to `CreateEntryUseCase(content, source)` and wraps its
66	  result.
67	- **Who calls it**: `InsertionModalBloc`, on `AudioSaveConfirmed`, `PhotoSaveConfirmed`, and
68	  `PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested` — the one shared seam for every entry this unit creates, parameterized only
69	  by `content` and `source` (research.md R7's consolidation rationale).
70	- **Deleted**: `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase.dart` and
71	  `save_photo_entry_usecase.dart` (and their `SaveAudioFailure`/`SavePhotoFailure` sealed types), along with
72	  their test files — fully superseded, no remaining caller.
73	
74	## `AudioTranscriptionRepository` / `PhotoRecognitionRepository` (unchanged interfaces, new call sites)
75	
76	Both interfaces (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/contracts/*.md`) keep their exact signatures —
77	`transcribe(String) -> Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` and
78	`recognize(String) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>`. This unit changes only *who* calls them and *when*:
79	`AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` is now called directly by `InsertionModalBloc` (no usecase — R1
80	removes the one orchestration step, the connectivity check, that used to justify a wrapper);
81	`PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` is now called only from inside `RecognizePhotoUseCase`, never
82	directly by the bloc.
83	
84	## RNF07 coverage this unit's tests must provide
85	
86	| Unit | Scenarios |
87	|---|---|
88	| `RecognizePhotoUseCase` | offline short-circuit (no repository call); repository `Right`; repository `Left(OcrNoTextFailure)`; repository `Left(<other Failure>)` — against a mock `PhotoRecognitionRepository` + fake `ConnectivityChecker`. |
89	| `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` | offline short-circuit (no `CreateEntryUseCase` call); `CreateEntryUseCase` `Right`; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Left` — against a mock `CreateEntryUseCase` + fake `ConnectivityChecker`. |
90	| `InsertionModalBloc` (bloc_test) | Áudio: stop → Processing → Transcribed (success) / Failure (empty/error); edited text carried into the create-entry call; Salvar double-tap ignored while Saving; stale-result guard (switch tabs mid-Processing, confirm the late result is dropped); retry re-uses the same path. Foto: the same shape, plus the offline-before-OCR path and "Salvar só a foto" creating an entry with the fixed placeholder and *no* further `recognize()` call. |
91

1	# Research: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing
2	
3	All unknowns this unit raises are implementation judgment calls on top of an already-resolved spec (spec.md's
4	three Clarifications) and an already-built RF01 pipeline — there is no new package, API, or external service
5	to evaluate. Each entry below either corrects an RF01 decision that no longer holds once recognition and save
6	are split apart, or fills a gap spec.md leaves to "reasonable technical decision" (Constitution Principle I).
7	
8	## R1 — Removing the pre-transcription connectivity gate for audio
9	
10	- **Decision**: `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` is called unconditionally on `AudioStopRequested`,
11	  with no `ConnectivityChecker` check beforehand. The connectivity gate moves to exactly one place for audio:
12	  immediately before `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`'s `entries-create` call (i.e., when the user taps "Salvar" from
13	  "Áudio — Transcrito").
14	- **Rationale**: RF01's research.md R5 (specs/003) checked connectivity *before* transcription too, but that
15	  was only sound because RF01's single combined usecase would otherwise burn a Whisper inference run for a
16	  save that could never complete regardless. Now that stopping a recording and tapping "Salvar" are two
17	  separate user actions (spec.md FR-001 vs. FR-002), gating transcription itself on connectivity would be
18	  wrong on its own terms: transcription is on-device (Constitution Principle II) and has no network dependency
19	  to protect; blocking it on "offline" would make an unrelated, free local operation fail for no reason, and
20	  would contradict FR-001's unconditional "the system MUST automatically begin on-device transcription" on
21	  stop. The spec's own Edge Cases only ever gate *writes* on connectivity ("'Salvar' ... and 'Salvar só a
22	  foto' both still require connectivity for the underlying `POST /entries` call") — never recognition itself
23	  for audio.
24	- **Alternatives considered**: Keeping RF01's pre-check in front of transcription anyway, "for consistency" —
25	  rejected: it would fail Story 2's Independent Test (forcing a transcription failure) in an environment
26	  that's merely offline but otherwise fine, and silently reclassifies "offline" as a transcription failure
27	  mode it structurally isn't.
28	
29	## R2 — Two new design tokens: the photo thumbnail and the recurring warning icon
30	
31	- **Decision**: Add exactly two entries to `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`:
32	  - `sizePhotoThumbnail = 64` — the "small thumbnail" prototype-extract.md §2.3 names for "Foto — Reconhecido"
33	    (next to the editable text) and "Foto — Erro" (kept on screen); one value, reused by both states.
34	  - `sizeStatusIcon = 32` — the red warning icon prototype-extract.md §2.3 names for both "Áudio — Erro" and
35	    "Foto — Erro"; one value, two call sites.
36	- **Rationale**: RF01's research.md R10 (specs/003) found no new token was needed because its own failure UI
37	  was deliberately plain (no icon, no thumbnail — research.md R11). This unit is precisely the one that must
38	  render the prototype's actual "Erro" states, which do name an icon and (for photo) a thumbnail the existing
39	  scale has no equivalent size for — the same bar RF03's research.md R3 (specs/002) already used ("a new token
40	  only when no existing value in the scale fits the exact shape needed, and it's reused at 2+ call sites, not
41	  a one-off"). Both qualify: two states each, not a single use. `colorError` (already present) is reused for
42	  the icon's color and the failure copy — no new color token needed.
43	- **Alternatives considered**: A single shared `sizeWarningIcon`/`sizeThumbnail` combined into one generic
44	  "status visual" token — rejected as it would conflate two different visual roles (an icon vs. an image
45	  thumbnail) for no reuse benefit, since they're never substituted for each other.
46	
47	## R3 — The fixed placeholder content for "Salvar só a foto"
48	
49	- **Decision**: The literal string `'Foto registrada sem texto reconhecido.'` is sent as `content` whenever
50	  "Salvar só a foto" is tapped (`EntrySource.photo`, no further OCR attempt for that capture — FR-008).
51	  Defined as a single `const` in the usecase call site (`InsertionModalBloc`), not duplicated anywhere else.
52	- **Rationale**: spec.md's own resolved Clarification 2 fixes the shape of this requirement (non-empty,
53	  backend-contract-compliant, `source: "photo"`) but explicitly leaves the exact wording to implementation
54	  ("exact wording left to implementation" — spec.md Assumptions). The chosen string is grammatically neutral
55	  Portuguese, describes exactly what happened (an entry was registered from a photo, no text was recognized),
56	  stays well under the 20000-char `content` limit, and is unambiguous if a user later sees it in a future
57	  history/search screen (RF07/RF06) without this unit needing to anticipate that screen's own design.
58	- **Alternatives considered**: Reusing the OCR failure message itself ("Não foi possível reconhecer o texto")
59	  as the stored content — rejected: that sentence describes a *process outcome*, not journal content, and
60	  would read strangely if ever surfaced as an entry's body text in a future timeline view.
61	
62	## R4 — Rendering the prototype's actual "Erro" states, closing RF01's documented carve-out
63	
64	- **Decision**: `CaptureFailureBand` (specs/003's deliberately plain placeholder — generic message + one
65	  outline "Tentar de novo" button, no icon) is removed from `capture_status_views.dart`. A new
66	  `RecognitionErrorView` widget renders prototype-extract.md §2.3's actual "Erro" shape: a
67	  `sizeStatusIcon`-sized warning icon in `colorError`, the exact copy ("Não foi possível transcrever" /
68	  "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto"), an outline "Tentar novamente" button, and — for Foto only — the
69	  secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". `CaptureLoadingIndicator` and `CapturePermissionDeniedMessage` are
70	  unchanged and keep serving their existing, still-applicable roles (the former embeds into the new
71	  "Processando"/"Processando OCR" layouts alongside the frozen waveform/thumbnail; the latter is untouched by
72	  this unit, since Idle/PermissionDenied/Recording/Captura states are RF01's, not RF02's, to redesign).
73	- **Rationale**: This is not a new judgment call so much as carrying out RF01's own research.md R11 (specs/
74	  003) to its stated conclusion: that entry explicitly named the "Erro" states as "RF02's screens to build,"
75	  not an open design question for this unit to re-litigate. spec.md's resolved Clarification 1 confirms it
76	  ("this unit replaces RF01's placeholder recognition UX... with the dedicated states the prototype
77	  defines").
78	- **Alternatives considered**: Keeping `CaptureFailureBand` around for some other, hypothetical use —
79	  rejected: nothing else in this codebase renders it once Áudio/Foto failures move to `RecognitionErrorView`,
80	  and keeping dead code around violates the "don't keep unused code for hypothetical future need" guidance
81	  this plan is held to; it is deleted outright, not deprecated.
82	
83	## R5 — A save-call failure after successful recognition gets its own (non-prototype-named) state, not a reuse of "Erro"
84	
85	- **Decision**: If `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` fails (offline, or the `entries-create` call itself fails) after
86	  the user taps "Salvar" from "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" — or taps "Salvar só a foto" from "Foto — Erro" — the
87	  bloc emits a new `*SaveFailure` state (`InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`/`InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`,
88	  data-model.md) that keeps the reviewed/edited text (and, for photo, the thumbnail) on screen with an inline
89	  error message, rather than falling back to the recognition-failure "Erro" state. Retrying is simply tapping
90	  "Salvar" (or "Salvar só a foto") again — no re-transcription, no re-OCR.
91	- **Rationale**: The prototype's "Erro" states (prototype-extract.md §2.3) are defined specifically for a
92	  *recognition* failure ("Não foi possível transcrever"/"...reconhecer o texto") — spec.md never describes a
93	  distinct screen for "recognition succeeded but the subsequent save failed," leaving this a genuine gap for
94	  reasonable technical judgment (Constitution Principle I). Falling back to "Erro" would be actively wrong
95	  here: it would discard the user's successfully-recognized (and possibly hand-edited) text to show a message
96	  about transcription/OCR, a step that already succeeded. This exactly mirrors an existing, already-approved
97	  precedent in this same codebase: the Texto tab's `InsertionModalTextoFailure` keeps the typed text visible
98	  and treats a second tap of the same "Salvar" button as its own retry (texto_tab_view.dart) — this unit
99	  applies that identical shape to Audio/Foto's post-review save step instead of inventing something new.
100	- **Alternatives considered**: Falling back silently to "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" with no visible error (just
101	  re-enabling "Salvar") — rejected: FR-009's "Erro" precedent and RNF09's "every write endpoint... handled" bar
102	  both imply the user must see *some* failure signal, not a silent no-op. Reusing "Erro" with its recognition
103	  copy substituted for a save-specific message — rejected as a confusing hybrid for the same reason RF01's own
104	  research.md R11 (specs/003) rejected partially borrowing a named state's look.
105	
106	## R6 — Guarding against a stale recognition result after abandonment
107	
108	- **Decision**: Before applying a `transcribe()`/`recognize()` result, the bloc re-checks that its *current*
109	  state is still the matching `*Processing` state for the same held file path (`_pendingAudioPath`/
110	  `_pendingImagePath` unchanged since the call started). If the user has since switched tabs, closed the
